# Love begins with taste

Yaratu is the meat brand of Kazan Delicacies: five cooked products from Kazan without sodium nitrite, with every compound mix listed ingredient by ingredient. For retailers and shoppers who need a checkable recipe.

## Five products. No ingredient-list shortcuts.

Calculated estimate per 100 g of raw recipe; not a laboratory value.

- [Chicken fillet ham](https://yaratu.com/en/products/vetchina/): Mild chicken ham with a fully disclosed ingredient list. 125 kcal, 16.7 g protein. Halal verified.
- [Mramornaya cooked smoked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/mramornaya/): Chicken and beef sausage with a savoury spiced profile. 264 kcal, 14.9 g protein. No halal claim.
- [Sausages with broccoli](https://yaratu.com/en/products/brokkoli/): Chicken and beef sausages with broccoli and gentle spices. 230 kcal, 13 g protein. Halal verified.
- [Molochnye milk sausages](https://yaratu.com/en/products/molochnye/): A mild classic profile with compound ingredients fully disclosed. 239 kcal, 13.5 g protein. Halal verified.
- [Slivochnaya cooked sausage](https://yaratu.com/en/products/slivochnaya/): A gentle creamy profile with a fully disclosed ingredient list. 174 kcal, 14.4 g protein. Halal verified.
